I farm this small maize plot near my compound, and even though I am old now, my children help me prepare the land. I will buy a little fertilizer because maize will not give good cobs without it, but I cannot afford much — maybe one bag of NPK if the price is fair. I always spread the goat and chicken droppings from my compound on the plot too. I save my own seed from last year's harvest like my mother taught me, and I do not buy the new seeds from the agro-dealer.
